canonical_derivatives: UTF-8 LF, selected fields; current local files, no staged blobs. Raw runtime evidence stays private.

transformations.historical-run-ledger.json: Select metrics, role model-request metadata and trace counts; no full request messages or host inventories.
transformations.historical-role-latency.json: Match completed role model_request/response pairs; exclude failed requests; not prefill/decode decomposition.
transformations.test-registry.json: Copy exact offline counts/failure IDs/source hashes, compare with prior packet.
transformations.controlled-functional.json: Selected real filesystem bytes, native gate outcomes, scripted model boundary.
transformations.live-run-registry.json: Selected bounded replay results and per-attempt source pins; no runtime databases.
transformations.independent-browser-readback.json: Drop absolute file URL; retain observed DOM and negative console/network checks.
